name: 75220 · Dallas, TX
findings: ZIP 75220 (Dallas) has 79 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75220 (Dallas) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 75220 (Dallas) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
